main.name: Agustín Musanti
main.heroTagline: I look for the best way to get things done: I cut the steps that don’t need to be there, automate the repetitive work, and leave the data ready for decisions.
main.heroSecondary: I work with data, BI, models, and AI agents. I don’t know every tool: when a problem calls for a new one, I learn it by using it.
